name: motif_sources
description:
List Sources. Lists the Sources the project's Motif Sources list holds, with their Context and any reason one cannot be used. Removed Sources are hidden unless asked for.
Command: source list. Agent class: Read.
all: Whether to list Removed Sources too; they are hidden otherwise.
Show one Source. Reads one Source: its Context as book and chapter ranges, how many chapters that is, its folder on this machine and its status.
Command: source show. Agent class: Read.
id: The Source id, such as WEB; matched ignoring case.
Place a chapter in the Sources. Says whether a chapter is in each Source's Context, is the Current chapter, or comes later.
Command: source where. Agent class: Read.
ref: The chapter, such as MAT 5.

id.description: One Source id, such as WEB. Omit to list every Source.

ref.description: A chapter such as MAT 5. Adds a place to each Source: InContext, Current or Later.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
